title: A Geometric Characterization of Maximal Unrefinable Partitions via the Keith-Nath Transformation and Young Diagrams
summary: We investigate the combinatorial structure of unrefinable partitions through their correspondence with numerical sets and Young diagrams. Building on the bijection introduced by Keith and Nath, we apply a general geometric criterion that links the unrefinability of a partition directly to the hook lengths of its associated Young diagram. This criterion provides a structural method for the characterization of any unrefinable partition.
